title: Long Mott (Dow / X-energy): 2026/10/02 - Comment (2) E-mail regarding LMGS CP Hearing [['General FR Notice Comment Letter']]

documents.text:
From:                  Max Chang <maxpchang@gmail.com>
Sent:                  Friday, October 2, 2026 11:17 AM
To:                    LMGS-CPHearing Resource
Subject:               [External_Sender] Docket No. 05-614; NRC-2025-0079 Comments

Honorable NRC Staff:

Please find below my comments regarding the proposed Long Mott Generating Station
currently before the NRC.

That X-Energy and LME have not provided public estimates of the cost of the proposed
plant since the initial award of the 50% ARDP cost share program is disturbing.

Recently, X-Energy received an additional $1 billion of DOE funding. That the ARDP DOE
funding is now up to $2.15 billion implies that the project cost has not increased to $4.3
billion up from ~$2.4 billion implied cost when X-Energy was first awarded the ARDP in
2021. It is also concerning that there does not appear to be any cap to the Federal funding
currently.

Sadly, the additional $1 billion in DOE funding had been taken from other DOE grantees.

Sincerely,

Max Chang
